div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
🌐 API: Get Device List
GET /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device
(full device inventory)

🌐 API: SDA Get Provisioned Devices
GET /dna/intent/api/v1/
sda/provisionDevices

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
📦 GROUP: Prep Body for Device
─────────────────────────────
① Copy requestBody → body
② JSONPath → hostname (by deviceId)
③ Replace String:
**REPLACE_DEVICE_ID** → deviceId
**REPLACE_DEVICE_HOSTNAME** → hostname
④ Set body = replaced result

🌐 API: SDA Provision Devices
POST /dna/intent/api/v1/
sda/provisionDevices
{siteId, networkDeviceId}

⏳ Wait For Catalyst Center Task
(poll taskId every 5s)

🌐 API: SDA Re-Provision Devices
PUT /dna/intent/api/v1/
sda/provisionDevices
{id, siteId, networkDeviceId}

⏳ Wait For Catalyst Center Task
(poll taskId every 5s)

📦 GROUP: Deploy Template
─────────────────────────────
① POST /dna/intent/api/v2/
template-programmer/template/deploy
body = device-specific JSON
② Sub-Workflow: Get Task ID
(parse taskId from response)
③ Wait For Catalyst Center Task
(poll taskId every 5s)

🔍 JSONPath → provisionedFlag & provisionedId
(check if device already provisioned at site)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
🌐 API: Get Template Versions
GET /dna/intent/api/v1/
templates/{templateId}/versions

💾 Complete Request Body
─────────────────────────────
Build full deployment JSON:
• isComposite
• targetInfo (with **REPLACE** placeholders)
• mainTemplateId
• templateId (versioned)
• forcePushTemplate: true
• memberTemplateDeploymentInfo: [...]

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;
div.span: 🔄 FOR EACH Member Template in containingTemplateArray

🌐 API: Get Template Details
GET /dna/intent/api/v2/
template-programmer/template
?id={memberTemplateId}

💾 Set memberTemplateDeploymentInfo
= new deployment JSON block
(with **REPLACE** placeholders)
counter++

💾 Append to memberTemplateDeploymentInfo
(comma-separated JSON block)
counter++

🔍 JSONPath → Child Details
─────────────────────────────
• childTemplateBody
• mainTemplateId
• isComposite
• params (parameterNames)
• defaultValue
• templateParams (full array)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
🌐 API: Get Template Details
GET /dna/intent/api/v2/
template-programmer/template
?id={templateId}

🔍 JSONPath Query
─────────────────────────────
• containingTemplateIds → array
• isComposite → boolean
• mainTemplateId

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
🔗 Sub-Workflow: Get-GitHub-File-v2
─────────────────────────────
Inputs: GITHUB_USER, GITHUB_REPO
GITHUB_PATH, GITHUB_FILE
─────────────────────────────
① Python: URL-encode repo/path/file
② HTTP GET → api.github.com
/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}/{file}
③ Set OUTPUT variable

🔍 JSONPath Query — settings.json
─────────────────────────────
Extract from GitHub file:
• HierarchyParent
• HierarchyArea
• HierarchyBldg
• HierarchyFloor
• templateTarget ➜ array
• templateName

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
🌐 API: Site Design Get Sites
GET /dna/intent/api/v1/sites
nameHierarchy =
Parent/Area/Bldg/Floor

div.span:
🌐 API: Get Project Details
GET /dna/intent/api/v2/
template-programmer/project
?name={Project Name}

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255); display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap;

div.span:
🔄 For Each IP in ipArray
─────────────────────
🔍 JSONPath → deviceId
by managementIpAddress
